Learning that fits every workday.

Spectra LMS goes where your people go: between client meetings, on a shift break, on the commute or at a home desk. Progress, points and engagement hours follow them from phone to laptop.

Five ways Spectra LMS is different by design.

Other LMSs are built to deliver courses and count completions. Spectra LMS is built to get people taking part. It measures engagement alongside learning, turns activity into insights you can act on, builds community and recognition into every course, and connects you to Edstellar's training and consulting whenever a gap appears.

01

Engagement hours, not just learning hours

Spectra LMS counts the time people spend taking part, in discussions, Q&A, feedback and kudos, alongside the time they spend in courses. Together, the two show who is truly involved in learning.

Everything L&D needs, in one LMS.

Six core modules share one learner record, so courses, live sessions, surveys and reports never sit in separate tools.

  • Courses and SCORM

    • Course library with modules, lessons and assessments
    • SCORM 1.2 and 2004 upload and built-in player
    • Auto-graded assessments with five question types
    • Upload eLearning, video, documents, slides and audio
    Learn more about Courses and SCORM

  • Learning paths and Assign Learning

    • Paths mixing courses, assessments, surveys and live sessions
    • Assign to the whole organization, departments or people
    • Due dates, rosters and automatic reminders
    • Self-enrollment from the course catalog
    Learn more about Learning paths and Assign Learning

  • Live training

    • ILT, VILT and webinars beside self-paced learning
    • Shared training calendar with session enrollment
    • Five-state attendance marking
    • Trainer workspace and session feedback
    Learn more about Live training

  • Surveys and feedback

    • Employee engagement and organizational climate surveys
    • Customer satisfaction and training feedback templates
    • Standard, compliance and deep-dive course feedback
    • Mandatory option and response window
    Learn more about Surveys and feedback

  • Reports and analytics

    • Organization dashboard with learning and engagement hours
    • Monthly learning hours against your target
    • Department comparison and learner profiles
    • CSV export for every report
    Learn more about Reports and analytics

  • Administration

    • User management with bulk upload
    • Roles and permissions, including billing admin and auditor
    • Notification management and audit log
    • A separate workspace for each organization
    Learn more about Administration

A learning cycle that keeps itself going.

Assignments, reminders, nudges, tracking and certificates form one loop. Certificates carry expiry dates, so you know when recertification is due.

See how learning paths work
Assign
Remind
Nudge
Track
Certify
Runs on its ownonce a course is set up
  1. 01

    Assign

    Assign learning to the whole organization, departments or named people, with due dates.

  2. 02

    Remind

    Deadline reminders and overdue alerts go out on their own.

  3. 03

    Nudge

    Inactivity nudges and weekly progress digests bring people back.

  4. 04

    Track

    Learning hours and engagement hours update as people learn and take part.

  5. 05

    Certify

    Certificates are issued on completion, with expiry dates for recertification.

  • Enterprise controls built in from day one

Role-based access

Five roles, from learner to super admin, each seeing only what it needs.

  • Learner, people manager, trainer, L&D admin and super admin
  • Each role adds only the views it needs
  • Change a person's role in one place
  • LearnerTheir own learning, community and recognition
  • People managerAdds the My Team view
  • TrainerAdds sessions, attendance and feedback
  • L&D adminAdds users, courses, reports and settings
  • Super adminAdds workspaces and security policies

Secure sign-in

Single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, session timeouts and password rules.

  • Single sign-on with Okta, Azure AD or Google Workspace
  • Multi-factor authentication
  • Session timeouts and password rules set by your admin
